title: 4. Design: make the service promise testable

rows: Define submitted, processing, paid and exception states.
Read current status; optionally subscribe to changes.
Identify caller and supplier; return only permitted records.
Distinguish unknown payment, delayed source and denied access.
Specify timestamps, version policy and consumer migration.

elements.text: Review the interaction with a real consumer before implementation.

notes:
Canonical station: Capability Solution & Interaction Design. Recommended resources: Domain Canvas, Capability Solution Design Canvas, Interaction Canvas and contract-first design. Select the contract or service definition appropriate to the architecture; an OpenAPI contract only covers an HTTP API portion.

The supplier-payment status capability is a newly authored fictional teaching example, not a client implementation or measured outcome. Figures, service promises and release criteria are illustrative proposals requiring validation. Working summaries are not reproductions of canonical canvas templates.
